_help: Mike's file list. Each entry is one tip, template or guide. 'who' lists the plans that can open it: free, starter, plus, parents. Plus members can open everything. The file must live in the folder that matches its lowest paid plan: starter/, plus/ or parents/. Guides people can buy on their own live in their own subfolder (plus/cv-kit/, parents/under-10/ and so on) and have a 'price'. Bundle bonus printables live in parents/bundle/. Free items link to the public site. A single parent guide also lists its own plan (guide_under10, guide_10to13 or guide_family) so people who bought just that one can open it. 'buy' is the Stripe Payment Link for buying that guide on its own (TEST links for now: swap for live links at launch).
